## About
Glenville Terrace Auto Body is part of a family owned and operated business. The Hynes family has been building trust in its car repair services for new and return customers, and Barry Hynes brings that experience to the Glenville Terrace location.
We're tucked between Parkvale Ave and Harvard Ave in Allston, easy to reach by car or the Green Line T. Our staff speaks several languages common to the Allston community, and you'll find Danny running the mechanical side, Rodrigo and Steve managing body work, and Emer in the office.
We do first class body, paint and repair work, insurance claim repairs and full maintenance. One reviewer wrote that Viet looked at the scratches on her door and buffed them out on the spot. Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating from 351 Google reviews.

## Services
- First class body, paint and repair work: Collision and body repair, with your paint restored to its pre loss condition.
- Tune ups: Regular tune ups to keep your car running right.
- Oil filter and lubrication: Oil, filter and lube as part of your regular maintenance.
- Brakes: Brake repair and service.
- Front-end alignment: Alignment along with shocks, exhaust and suspension work.
- Transmissions: Transmission repair, plus clutches and radiators.
- Diagnostics: We'll find out what's wrong before we fix it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Most likely. We're a preferred referral shop for most insurance companies in Massachusetts, including Arbella, Safety, Commerce, Plymouth Rock, Geico, Progressive, Travelers and Amica.

Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: We offer free consultation and appointments, and we're open 6 days a week.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept MasterCard, Discover, Visa, American Express and Travelers Check, as well as payment by check.

Q: How do I get to the shop?
A: We're on Glenville Terrace, between Parkvale Ave and Harvard Ave. Come by car or take the Green Line T to Allston.

On top of that, I asked about a few additional cosmetic touch-ups outside of the insurance claim, and they were able to take care of everything at a very reasonable price.

They also made the whole process super convenient, I was able to leave my rental car there, and they handled returning it to Enterprise for me, which saved me a lot of time.
